title: Extract and account for every SRD table document-wide
description:
Problem

The latest audit found that table coverage is still incomplete. The pack has more table records than before, but many SRD tables are still missing or flattened into prose.

High-confidence missing or insufficiently represented examples

- Dragonborn Draconic Ancestry table, p. 5.
- The 12 class progression tables.
- Druid Circle Spells tables.
- Oath of Devotion Spells table.
- Sorcerer Creating Spell Slots table.
- Draconic Bloodline Draconic Ancestry table.
- Apparatus of the Crab Levers table.
- Bag of Beans tables.
- Bag of Tricks table.
- Carpet of Flying table.
- Feather Token table.
- Horn of Valhalla table.
- Iron Flask table.
- Robe of Useful Items table.
- Wand of Wonder table.
- Sentient magic item property tables.
- Other magic-item option tables with dice rows or named choices.

Task

Make table extraction document-wide and require every source table to be accounted for.

Implementation guidance

- Use PDF text and coordinate artifacts where needed.
- Detect table captions, heading-adjacent tables, repeated column-header patterns, and dice-result tables.
- Do not limit table extraction to one chapter or to previously known tables.
- Preserve source row order, typography, and page provenance.
- For nested/grouped tables, use the representation already chosen for the importer, or document and test the chosen representation if not yet formalized.
- Some tables may ultimately become structured child data rather than top-level table records. That is acceptable if the coverage gate records the mapping.

Tests

Add regression tests for at least:

- Dragonborn Draconic Ancestry.
- One class progression table.
- One subclass spell table.
- Sorcerer Creating Spell Slots.
- One magic-item dice-result table.
- One magic-item option/property table.

Acceptance criteria

- Document-wide source table inventory exists.
- Every detected table is emitted, mapped to structured child data, or explicitly ignored.
- Known missing tables from the audit no longer disappear into prose without accounting.
- Table parsing fails closed when expected row counts or headers change.
notes: PR #195 review fix pushed (a68115c): coverage evaluator now resolves explicit record-type rules BEFORE the name auto-match, fixing the duplicate-caption bug where both 'Draconic Ancestry' captions (p5 Races, p44 Sorcerer) were claimed by table:draconic-ancestry. p44 now maps to table:draconic-bloodline-draconic-ancestry via an explicit per-chapter record rule; sentinels + evaluator unit tests pin both mappings. Close this bead when the PR merges.
close_reason: Merged as PR #195 (7a5684c): 24 document-wide tables emitted via parseDocumentTables (table kind 29->53), 4a7.3 coverage catch-all removed, every table item explicitly accounted (4a7.6/4a7.8/4a7.10/eshyra-o4j7 scoped gaps), duplicate Draconic Ancestry captions mapped to distinct records via record-rule precedence.
